propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if() conditions during workflow cancellation; always() predicates remain true and prevent stale matrix/reusable jobs from being canceled.
Commit 6f4123678c added always() predicates to seven full-route jobs, causing superseded runs to consume 1,785 runner-seconds and delay successor job creation by 1,510 seconds.

Replacing the leading always() functions with !cancelled() status checks in seven full-route job predicates makes those jobs ineligible when the run is canceled while preserving classifier-failure fallback behavior.

Live post-merge organic same-change replacements (run 31846910968→31847788055, run 31847788055→31849555779) demonstrated stale jobs canceled within 60–110 seconds of replacement creation without waiting for natural completion.
